neighbours.label: the word that completes a routine or substitution phrase ('condition as usual', 'instead of two', 'in a timely manner'), as against the same instructions without the fixed phrase; weak guess
fire: Shampoo your hair, then rinse and dry as usual before styling.
The recipe uses honey instead of sugar for a softer taste.
After the holiday, classes will resume as usual on Monday.
The patient was given a smaller dose instead of the full one.
Trains are running as usual despite the heavy snow.
At the meeting she chose tea instead of coffee.
Tenants should report any leaks to the landlord in a timely manner.
Mix the paint well and apply it as usual with a soft brush.
quiet: Shampoo your hair, then rinse and dry it with a warm towel.
The recipe uses a spoon of honey for a softer taste.
After the holiday, classes will resume on Monday morning.
The patient was given a smaller part of the full dose.
Trains are running slowly despite the heavy snow.
At the meeting she chose a cup of tea.
Tenants should report any leaks to the landlord by phone.
Mix the paint well and apply it with a soft brush.
